author: zZJx03Zz
body:
Hey doods! Currently, me and SnakeV3nom10 are working on a nebula map called Bloodbath. Below you will find some information on it.

We aim for Bloodbath to be a map where the center island allows the players to obtain higher-tier gear and fight to death to become the team dominating. A large tower stands in the exact middle point of the map, in which the upgrade items will held in. We may also possibly place diamond blocks to boost the competition. So far, we are planning on having a considerably large amount of monuments - maybe 4 or 5. This is because we don't want are map to be [easily] rush able. Are map was created for the pvp, however you will still be able to destroy the monuments, just not a quickly and simply as some other maps. Another desire is to make it only a few blocks void, which will help the current disaster of falling out the world. 
The amour you get, compared to other maps, wil be highly valued. We are planning on having iron chest plate and leggings and then leather cap and boots. This will make the duration of pvp longer and hopefully more fun. One of the reasons why we did this, is because the lucky people who manage to get diamond amour won't be able to kill the other people as easy. We believe, on zalidor, for example, the diamond amour is too overpowering. The starting amour is only a leather cap, so basically the team who has a quick builder wins. Well, not with this map. Linking with name, bloodbath, the teams will be Blood and water, colours: (Red and blue). We want to hear what you guys think. Any questions compliments or statements on how to make it better, drop by a message. Below you will find some screenshots of the Bloods spawn. Thanks, MC and snake!
